quantum-cortex, original figure. Three things it is for, as measured; nothing more is claimed
A memory with exact withdrawal and

g.text: a long running matter (a project, a case, a
correspondence) whose record a fresh session must
find months later, cite line by line, and answer
"no record" on what was never written
the companion demonstration is that use, on the
organ's own code path
what is withdrawn is withdrawn; what is cited is a
pointer to a sealed line, never a paraphrase
row 42
the sealed families, the references, the cost harness and
the record tests are a way to measure any memory organ
against the simplest stack on the same questions, with the
construction's own ceiling read beside (rows 51 to 54): the
measurements that made this organ's limit visible are
reusable on the next one
the provenance benchmark packages that use: a bench
from the sealed generator, your system's answers scored
with the record's reading and its frozen conditions,
without the model and without the organ; your numbers are
yours, and the record claims nothing from them

svg.text: A worked example of a falsifiable record

g.text: every measurement declared before it ran, with the
readings of every outcome
every file retained before a number in it was read
the failures published in the same table as the rest,
and a reviewer can recompute every digit
the account of how it was made, with a language
model as design and review partner under that
discipline, is docs/JOURNEY.md

svg.text: It is not a product, not a chat model, and not a claim about larger models

g.text: what you can run on your own matter or your own organ
what you can read and recompute
what it is not
